title: More control over text generation
summary:
Text generation gained sampling controls, SillyTavern’s listing got clearer, and authentication stopped treating a bad token like a server-ending event.

Text requests now pass temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, and frequency_penalty through to OpenAI-compatible providers. Supplied values take precedence over model defaults, and the parameters are documented for GET and POST requests.

The website and README now list SillyTavern as using Pollinations for both text and image generation. The integration itself did not change.

Text and image services now share authentication and queue handling. Invalid tokens return a 401 instead of crashing the text server, and token validation has a GET endpoint.

daily.title: Tune text sampling
daily.text: Set `temperature`, `top_p`, `presence_penalty`, and `frequency_penalty` in text GET or POST requests. Your values take precedence over model defaults. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
